mainEntity.name: Is Grillz of Punjab a pure vegetarian restaurant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Grillz of Punjab is a 100% pure vegetarian restro and cafe in Dhampur. The full menu — tandoori starters, chaap, paneer, Chinese, pizza, thali and cafe drinks — is vegetarian.

mainEntity.name: Where is Grillz of Punjab in Dhampur?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grillz of Punjab is opposite Axis Bank, near Punjabi Colony, Dhampur, District Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh 246761. It is a short ride from Dhampur Railway Station.

mainEntity.name: What are the opening hours of Grillz of Punjab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grillz of Punjab is open daily from 12:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

mainEntity.name: Does Grillz of Punjab offer home delivery in Dhampur?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Free home delivery is available on orders above Rs. 499. Call or WhatsApp +91 63953 66055 or +91 74549 51842 to place an order.

mainEntity.name: What food does Grillz of Punjab serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The kitchen serves Indian and Punjabi tandoori dishes, Chinese, pizza, burgers, thali combos and cafe drinks. Signature plates include paneer tikka, malai chaap, special meal thali and chhole bhature.

mainEntity.name: How can I order from Grillz of Punjab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call +91 63953 66055 or WhatsApp the same number. A second line, +91 74549 51842, is available for delivery.
